name: Macron WoW64 OpenGL probe
notes: A small OpenGL program from tools/wow64-gl-probe that creates contexts the way wined3d does, without Direct3D, to reproduce Wine's 32-on-64 OpenGL crash on Apple's OpenGL (MACRON_OPENGL=apple-software on a runner). Its profile is the default one, like d3d9-fps-probe's.
